question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping maintains firm control over the Chinese Communist Party, state institutions, and the military as of mid-2026, with no designated successor or visible internal challenges positioned to force his removal before the 21st Party Congress. Recent military purges have further centralized authority under loyalists, while the absence of term limits and precedent for a fourth term support expectations that he will be reappointed to core posts in 2027. Trader consensus at 95.5% for "No" reflects these structural realities and the low visibility of elite opposition or succession signaling within the current leadership cohort. Unforeseen developments such as a severe health crisis, major economic disruption triggering elite fractures, or sudden external shocks could still alter trajectories, though such events remain outside established patterns of CCP power transitions.
